title: UpdatePendingPayload

updateId.description: An update's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it takes a target, named by each of the update's notices, the launcher's switch, its database snapshot and its outcome record; a newer release replacing the target gets a new one.

toVersion.description: The version the update goes to.

source.description: Where a pending update comes from: channel (the channel's newest release, auto-update being on), pin (the pinned version), request (updates.apply or POST /api/update by version) or desktop (the artefact a desktop handed its local environment).

since.description: When an update first became pending: kept when a newer release replaces the target, and across restarts, so frequent releases never reset the cap's clock.

deferUntil.description: since plus the deferral cap: past it, busy work no longer holds the update.

image.description: Managed outside, the target's image from its release manifest, which the host-side updater pulls and checks; absent for a native environment's update.

reference.description: The image's reference, tagged with the exact version: git.systemtech.dev:5526/david/agent-harness:0.5.0.

digest.description: The image's digest, sha256: then 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits: a pull is checked against it.

description: An update is pending: its id, the version it goes to, where it comes from, since when, when the deferral cap forces it, and, managed outside, its image.
